x1r89x5p.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
x1r89x5p.sourceDescription: Our MD's favourite! With a classic upturned shape and incorporating super lifelike PE plastic moulded branch tips, we love the final look of this 7ft pre-lit Christmas tree. The Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine's curved outer branches not only provide an eye-catching silhouette but they also create plenty of space to hang pretty Christmas tree decorations. Our customers love how full and bushy the Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine looks year after year. It is also one of our easiest 7ft Christmas trees to erect. That's thanks to the hinged and contoured branches that effortlessly fall into place (you just need to tweak the inner branches a little to fill the gaps) and the ready-lit branches. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. mft2shac.variantName: Dellonda 6ft Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 270 Warm LED Lights - Green
mft2shac.sourceDescription: This realistic Dellonda 6ft Christmas Tree is perfect for a standard family living room. Pre-Lit with 270 warm white LED lights to save the hassle and arguments of untangling the never ending knot of lights! Our Xmas Trees are specially designed to include very realistic pine branches using PE tips. We then use PVC construction for the trunk to make the tree look naturally strong, full and bushy. Our trees are tested to and comply with EN71-2 Flammability Clause 4. This includes the required tests concerning the flammability of a product. Made up of 1,224 PE/PVC branch tips to give a natural and realistic look and feel. Hinged branches make this Christmas tree easy to assemble and store away. Includes strong sturdy metal base, which folds away for easy storage. Tree Width: 43". Suitable for indoor use only! ra9p6hvc.variantName: Christmas Tree World 100cm Red Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
ra9p6hvc.sourceDescription: Introducing the 100cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Red, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home. Featuring a sleek mirror finish, this inflatable display ball reflects light and surroundings beautifully, making it ideal for eye-catching shop windows, visual merchandising, brand activations, and large-scale installations. A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. Once deflated or with the air removed using a compatible electric pump the display ball folds down to a fraction of its inflated size, making off-season storage simple and space-efficient. Manufactured from fire-retardant materials, the Inflatable Mirror Display Ball is suitable for use in commercial and public spaces. It is inflated once, sealed securely, and displayed without the need for a continuous power supply.
